title: Three teams, two places: Group A1 goes to the last night in Brussels and Paris
summary: Italy and France sit level on 10 points from five games, with Belgium one behind, and Sunday's closing fixtures run simultaneously at 20:45 CET: Belgium host Italy, France host a Türkiye side already fixed in fourth. Italy top the group by winning, or by drawing if France fail to win. Belgium reach the quarter-finals only by beating Italy; France need a draw against Türkiye, or a Belgian slip, to be sure of joining them.
